// diagnostic

E0174

`{type}` has no `{from} -> {to}` in its state list

What

`{type}` has no `{from} -> {to}` in its state list

Why

`{op}` takes `{type}.{from}` and returns `{type}.{to}`, so it is a move, and every move is an arrow in the state list

Fix

Add `{from} -> {to}` to the state list of `{type}`, or start from a state that has that arrow

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0174: tests/ui/typestate/state_type_move_without_arrow.stderr.

Error [jet.TypestateMoveWithoutArrow]: `Order` has no `Draft -> Shipped` in its state list
  --> tests/ui/typestate/state_type_move_without_arrow.jet:11:38
    |
 11 |     ship: fn(self: &&Order.Draft) -> Order.Shipped { self }
    |                                      ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `ship` takes `Order.Draft` and returns `Order.Shipped`, so it is a move, and every move is an arrow in the state list
 Fix: Add `Draft -> Shipped` to the state list of `Order`, or start from `Order.Confirmed`
